effects: Admin-only (PLATFORM_ADMIN): sets whitelistedAddresses[_address] = true so that address can deposit ETH while the whitelist is on. No assets move.
formats.shown: Add to whitelist, with the address being added.

effects: Sets the signer's rswETH allowance for spender to exactly amount, replacing any earlier allowance. No tokens move.
formats.shown: Approve spender, with the spender address and the amount in rswETH, or 'Unlimited' at or above 2^255.

cases.notes: The 0.25 RSWETH approval to 0x6a00…1068 matches the screen.
The max-uint approval to 0x40aa…cd7f is shown as 'Unlimited rswETH'.

effects: Admin-only: adds each listed address to the deposit whitelist. Reverts if any address is zero or already listed. No assets move.
formats.shown: Add to whitelist, with every address listed.

effects: Admin-only: removes each listed address from the deposit whitelist, so it can no longer deposit while the whitelist is on. No assets move.
formats.shown: Remove addresses, with every address listed.

findings.title: batchRemoveFromWhitelist intent 'Remove addresses' does not say they are removed from the whitelist.
findings.evidence: Whitelist.sol batchRemoveFromWhitelist → _checkAndRemoveFromWhitelist sets whitelistedAddresses[_address] = false; descriptor intent "Remove addresses"
findings.fix: Use the intent "Remove from whitelist", matching the add formats.

effects: Destroys amount of the signer's rswETH (_burn(msg.sender, amount)). Nothing is returned for it.
formats.shown: Burn tokens, with the amount in rswETH.

effects: Lowers the signer's rswETH allowance for spender by subtractedValue. Reverts if the result would go below zero. No tokens move.
formats.shown: Decrease allowance, with the spender and the amount subtracted in rswETH.

effects: Callable only by the DepositManager contract. Mints rswETH to _to: _amount divided by the stored rswETH/ETH rate, and at least _minRswETH or the call reverts.
No ETH moves in this call (the function is not payable). _amount is only used for the calculation.
formats.shown: Deposit via Manager, with Amount '2 ETH', the To address and a raw Min Rsw ETH integer.

findings.title: depositViaDepositManager shows the minimum rswETH minted as a raw integer.
findings.evidence: descriptor field 'Min Rsw ETH' format raw on #._minRswETH; case 8 shows "1900000000000000000". RswETH.sol depositViaDepositManager reverts if rswETHAmount < _minRswETH.
findings.fix: Use tokenAmount with token $.metadata.constants.swellToken and the label 'Minimum rswETH received'.

findings.title: depositViaDepositManager shows 'Amount 2 ETH', but no ETH leaves in this call.
findings.evidence: RswETH.sol depositViaDepositManager is non-payable and only uses _amount to compute rswETHAmount; descriptor field 'Amount' format amount on #._amount renders "2 ETH" (case 8).
findings.fix: Label it 'ETH credited (already held by Deposit Manager)'. Make the intent say 'Mint rswETH to recipient for ETH already deposited'.

findings.title: depositViaDepositManager intent does not say that rswETH is minted to _to.
findings.evidence: RswETH.sol depositViaDepositManager: _mint(_to, rswETHAmount); descriptor intent "Deposit via Manager"; field label 'To' does not say rswETH goes there.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Mint rswETH for deposited ETH' and relabel _to as 'rswETH recipient'.

effects: Sends msg.value ETH from the signer, which is forwarded to the DepositManager.
Mints rswETH to the signer: msg.value divided by the stored rswETH/ETH rate.
Records the referral address in an event only. The signer cannot refer itself, and must be whitelisted while the whitelist is on.
formats.shown: Deposit, with the referral address and the ETH amount sent (@.value).

findings.title: depositWithReferral does not show how much rswETH the signer receives; it depends on the stored rate.
findings.evidence: RswETH.sol _deposit: rswETHAmount = msg.value * 1e18 / _rswETHToETHRate(); _mint(msg.sender, rswETHAmount). There is no calldata parameter for a minimum.
findings.fix: No field can show it. Optionally say 'receive rswETH' in the intent.

findings.title: depositWithReferral intent 'Deposit' does not name ETH in or rswETH out.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Deposit"; RswETH.sol _deposit mints rswETH to msg.sender in exchange for msg.value.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Stake ETH for rswETH' and an interpolatedIntent like 'Stake {@.value} for rswETH (referral {referral})'.

effects: Raises the signer's rswETH allowance for spender by addedValue. No tokens move.
formats.shown: Increase allowance, with the spender and the added amount in rswETH, or 'Unlimited' at or above 2^255.

findings.title: increaseAllowance test case 11 sends value 1 to a non-payable function, which would revert.
findings.evidence: cases/11.json input.value "1"; ERC20Upgradeable.increaseAllowance is not payable.
findings.fix: Set value to 0 in the test case.

effects: Admin-only: sets whitelistedAddresses[_address] = false, so that address can no longer deposit while the whitelist is on. No assets move.
REPRICER-only: sets the new rswETH/ETH rate from the given reserves, rewards and supply. This changes the value of every holder's rswETH.
Mints reward rswETH to node operator reward addresses and to the Swell treasury. None goes to the signer.
formats.shown: Reprice, with three raw integers: pre-reward reserves, new ETH rewards and rswETH total supply.

findings.title: reprice shows ETH reserves, rewards and rswETH supply as raw wei integers.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields on #._preRewardETHReserves, #._newETHRewards and #._rswETHTotalSupply all use format raw; case 13 shows "100000000000000000000" etc.
findings.fix: Use format amount for the two ETH values, and tokenAmount with token $.metadata.constants.swellToken for the supply.

findings.title: reprice intent does not say it updates the exchange rate and mints reward rswETH to operators and the treasury.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Update rswETH rate and mint rewards'.

effects: Sends amount rswETH from the signer to to.
formats.shown: Transfer Tokens, with the recipient and the amount in rswETH.

cases.notes: 0.8856 RSWETH out to 0x7e70…6966 matches the screen.

formats.key: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
effects: Moves amount rswETH from from to to, spending the signer's allowance from from by amount (unless it is unlimited).
formats.shown: Transfer From, with the from address, the to address and the amount in rswETH.

effects: PLATFORM_ADMIN-only: sends the rswETH contract's entire balance of _token to the signer.
formats.shown: Withdraw ERC-20 token, with the token address.

findings.title: withdrawERC20 does not show the amount: the contract's whole balance, read from storage.
findings.fix: No field can show the balance. Say 'Withdraw all of this token held by rswETH to you' in the intent.
